recentItems.title: Ramdev (1963) Full Movie | Mahipal, Anita Guha | Rajasthani Devotional Movie | Old Indian Movie
recentItems.description:
Watch Ramdev (1963), a classic biographical and devotional drama inspired by the life, legends and spiritual legacy of Ramdev Pir, also known as Baba Ramdev, Ramdevji or Ramdev Pir, a revered folk saint associated with Rajasthan and Gujarat.

Synopsis
Core Subject: The film is a biographical and devotional drama based on the life and legends of Ramdev Pir (also known as Ramdevji or Baba Ramdev), a revered 14th-century Hindu folk deity of Rajasthan and Gujarat.
Miracles and Teachings: The story portrays his divine birth as the son of Raja Ajmal Ji, his miraculous powers manifested from a young age, and his lifelong mission to fight social discrimination.
Uplifting the Downtrodden: The narrative tracks how he devoted himself to protecting and uplifting the poor, downtrodden, and distressed people of Marwar, earning deep reverence across communities as a saint and warrior.
Legacy: The movie highlights key regional folklore, societal trials faced by his family, and his ultimate spiritual standing, featuring popular devotional tracks like "Khamma Khamma". It became a major commercial success and a historical milestone for Rajasthani cinema.

Banner: Ranglok Presents
